title: Bitcoin stolen from Binance tops Tesla’s holdings and is over twice El Salvador’s reserve
summary: The 18,270 BTC haul is worth about $1.4 billion and comes within 442 coins of SpaceX’s disclosed holdings. Blockchain investigators link the attack to North Korea.

title: OpenAI reportedly cuts fundraising and valuation targets amid AI jitters
summary: Anxiety about the AI boom has sent the Nasdaq 100 slumping by about 10% in just three weeks since hitting a record high on October 6, including a 4.5% drop on Friday.

title: Experts divided over Binance hack asset freezes, warn recovery is another matter
summary: Tether, Circle and others moved within hours to block billions in stolen crypto, but legal experts question whether smaller victims would get the same protection.

title: Binance uncovers wider breach in $6.3 billion exploit, targets Sunday withdrawal restart
summary: CEO Richard Teng said hackers erased evidence and bypassed security checks. Binance plans to publish its proof of reserves Monday.

title: Wall Street analysts urge investors to buy crypto stocks after $6.3 billion Binance hack
summary: Analysts at Cantor Fitzgerald, TD Cowen and Compass Point say the $6.3 billion Binance hack is unlikely to derail the crypto market's recovery.
